module_metadata.purpose: Strict 6-part .tscn ordering, node_paths=PackedStringArray, unique_name_in_owner, procedural Polygon2D visuals, and exact project.godot physical keycodes.

strict_tscn_section_order: 3. [sub_resource type="..." id="..."] (ALL sub_resources MUST appear BEFORE any [node] block!)
4. [node name="Root" type="..."] (Root node has NO parent attribute)
5. [node name="Child" type="..." parent="."] (Child nodes in hierarchy order)

node_paths_and_unique_names.exported_node_reference:
[node name="Manager" type="Node" parent="." node_paths=PackedStringArray("player", "spawn_points")]
player = NodePath("../Player")
spawn_points = [NodePath("../Spawn1"), NodePath("../Spawn2")]
node_paths_and_unique_names.unique_name_in_owner: Add `unique_name_in_owner = true` inside a `[node]` block so scripts can reference it via `%NodeName`.

visual_placeholder_rule.rule: `CharacterBody2D`, `StaticBody2D`, `RigidBody2D`, `Area2D`, and `CollisionShape2D` are completely INVISIBLE at runtime! Always attach a `Polygon2D`, `ColorRect`, `Line2D`, or `Sprite2D` child node to every entity so scenes are immediately visible.

project_godot_exact_physical_keycodes.runtime_fallback_helper: Always include a static or `_ready()` helper using `InputMap.has_action()` / `InputMap.add_action()` so custom actions work even if `project.godot` was not edited.
